title: Name a local number
summary: T-SQL: Name a local number. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: DECLARE makes a local variable. T-SQL variable names start with @.
learningObjectives: Name a local number with T-SQL

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.
DECLARE creates @pencils as int 3. The SELECT expression adds 2.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The variable exists only in its batch or procedure scope.
